items.prompt:
Earth's outer layer is broken into large moving pieces called:
A) Fossils
B) Tectonic plates
C) Oceans
D) Craters

steps: These large moving pieces are tectonic plates.

items.prompt:
The coastlines of South America and Africa appear to:
A) Be identical in size
B) Fit together like puzzle pieces
C) Repel each other
D) Have no shape
items.answer: B) Fit together like puzzle pieces

steps: Their fitting shapes suggest they were once joined.

items.prompt:
Tectonic plates move:
A) Very quickly
B) Slowly over time
C) Never
D) Only during eclipses

steps: Plates move slowly over long periods.

items.prompt:
The same fossil species found on two continents separated by an ocean suggests:
A) The species swam across
B) The continents were once connected
C) Fossils can fly
D) Nothing
items.answer: B) The continents were once connected

steps: The species could not cross the ocean, so the continents were once joined.

items.prompt:
Matching mountain ranges on continents separated by an ocean suggest they:
A) Were built yesterday
B) Were once joined and later moved apart
C) Are unrelated
D) Are fossils
items.answer: B) Were once joined and later moved apart

steps: Matching features indicate a past connection before the plates moved apart.

items.prompt:
Where is the youngest rock on the seafloor found?
A) Near the shore
B) Near mid-ocean ridges
C) In deep trenches only
D) Nowhere

steps: New seafloor forms at mid-ocean ridges, so rock is youngest there.

items.prompt:
Why do scientists use several kinds of evidence (fossils, rocks, coastlines) for plate motion?
A) To make it confusing
B) Because many lines of evidence together make the conclusion stronger
C) Because one is enough
D) They do not use evidence
items.answer: B) Because many lines of evidence together make the conclusion stronger

steps: Agreement across multiple lines of evidence strengthens the conclusion.

items.prompt:
Seafloor rock being youngest at the ridge and older farther away is evidence that:
A) The seafloor never moves
B) The seafloor spreads apart from the ridge
C) Rocks get younger with distance
D) Ridges destroy rock
items.answer: B) The seafloor spreads apart from the ridge

steps: New rock forms at the ridge and spreads outward, aging with distance.
